parsed.explanation: Enforced criminalisation plus documented state-tolerated targeting places this in the severe band. Police are documented perpetrators, not protectors: violence and harassment based on gender identity, prolonged detentions, and routine bribe extortion using threatened ancillary charges. Imprisonment is real and current (a 2024 profile of a three-year term, 15 years' hard labour available), and prosecutions employ forced anal examinations — state-perpetrated sexual violence a rights body likens to torture. Recourse is effectively nil: no LGBTQ assembly or organisations, officials won't rescue discriminatory laws, and a 2015 mob attack included police officers. Society is hostile (a 2022 presidential statement triggering a spike in hate speech and assaults; organised anti-gay NGO). Trans presentation isn't itself criminalised and the anal-exam practice is dated, but police gender-identity harassment and the sex-conduct lever reach an outed visitor directly, with imprisonment and torture as the governing worst case.
